title: King Vikram and the spirit in the tree.
lines: Long ago in India there was a brave and wise king.
One day a sorcerer came to the palace.
In the forest there's an old tree.
A spirit lives in that tree.
But you mustn't say anything on the way.
He went to the forest at night.
And hanging from a branch was Betaal.
A funny spirit, with long arms and big eyes.
He was hanging upside down like a bat.
He grabbed Betaal and put him on his back.
Betaal said: It's a long way.
At the end I'll ask a question.
If you know the answer, you must say it.
But if you say anything, I'll fly back to my tree!
Their father gave them an old elephant.
The first brother wanted to sell the elephant.
The second brother wanted to make it work.
The third brother said: This elephant has worked for us all our lives.
Let's let him rest and take good care of him.
Betaal asked: Which brother was the wisest?
Because he was grateful and kind to the elephant.
And whoosh, he flew back to the tree.
He put Betaal on his back again.
About a clever princess and a silly little deer.
And again he asked a question.
And again Vikram knew the answer.
It went on like that all night.
At the end Betaal asked a very difficult question.
Vikram thought for a long time.
You only say something when you really know it.
Betaal told him one more secret.
He wants to steal your palace.
Vikram took Betaal to the sorcerer.
He didn't let himself be tricked.
The sorcerer ran away and never came back.
Sometimes Vikram went to the old tree at night.
Then Betaal would tell him a new story.
